description: This plot illustrates the training loss over a number of iterations for six different model configurations: Vanilla, StrmLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=64, H), SepLLM (n=64, H/T), and SepLLM (n=128). The x-axis is labeled "#Iteration" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 140,000, with tick marks at regular intervals of 20,000. The y-axis is labeled "Loss" and uses a linear scale ranging from 2.4 to 3.4, with tick marks at regular intervals of 0.1. All six lines are solid without distinct markers, feature a lighter shaded region around the main line, and exhibit a similar trend: a sharp initial decline from above 3.4 near iteration 0, followed by a gradual, steady decrease through the end of the x-axis. The purple line, representing "Vanilla," drops to approximately 2.7 by iteration 10,000 and ends at roughly 2.46 at iteration 140,000. The blue line, representing "StrmLLM (n=64)," drops to approximately 2.9 by iteration 10,000 and ends at roughly 2.61 at iteration 140,000. The orange line, representing "SepLLM (n=64)," drops to approximately 2.75 by iteration 10,000 and ends at roughly 2.52 at iteration 140,000. The green line, representing "SepLLM (n=64, H)," closely follows the orange line, dropping to approximately 2.75 by iteration 10,000 and ending at roughly 2.51 at iteration 140,000. The red line, representing "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)," drops to approximately 2.7 by iteration 10,000 and ends at roughly 2.49 at iteration 140,000. Finally, the dark blue line, representing "SepLLM (n=128)," drops to approximately 2.75 by iteration 10,000 and ends at roughly 2.50 at iteration 140,000.
